gaps.text: Inside ≥30% O2 at ≤70.3 kPa, solids were burned at 20 cm/s airflow only; no solid test in this window at any other flow.
Only 2 solid materials burned in ≥30% O2 at ≤70.3 kPa: SIBAL Cloth; Two-Sided PMMA.
